requirement.statement: Active halfcode contracts, loaders, codecs, compilers, fixtures, and runtime assembly SHALL contain no Intent compatibility model, alias, domain, URI scheme, or dedicated retired-vocabulary branch.

case.given: a canonical FrontendApp or unit bundle is loaded
case.when: the loader builds contract and runtime inputs
case.then: only Command/Event/Message vocabulary SHALL be present in the active model

case.given: the support and logic packages are compiled
case.when: their public exports and source are inspected
case.then: no Intent type, legacy domain, or compatibility codec SHALL be exported or referenced

requirement.statement: Canonical test fixtures SHALL use only Commands, Events, commands://, events://, Sends, MessagePolicy, and identity-preserving Wire.message; historical Intent fixture directories SHALL be removed.

case.then: the bundles SHALL load and retain runtime-first Command and Event behavior

requirement.statement: Active full-code command-dispatch APIs SHALL use commands terminology, including CRUD adapters and flow-editor runtime objects; AppEvent SHALL remain the generic value envelope.

case.given: a full-code CRUD consumer creates a Vue or Element Plus adapter
case.then: the API SHALL expose CrudCommands through a commands property

case.given: a workbench flow editor invokes a runtime command
case.when: the command is sent to the graph/runtime boundary
case.then: the public runtime object SHALL expose commands and command-named helpers

requirement.statement: After cleanup, active source, halfcode documentation, and canonical fixtures SHALL contain no retired Intent vocabulary; Codument audit history MAY retain it as historical record only.

case.given: the active source, docs, and fixture roots of both repositories
case.when: a case-insensitive scan searches for Intent, OnIntent, IntentPolicy, intents://, or related fields
case.then: the scan SHALL return no matches outside the explicit track being implemented
